preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A <= 1000000 and 0 <= B <= 1000000 and 0 <= C <= 1000000 for A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, and C are between 0 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(A + B + C >= 1 for A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sum of A, B, and C is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'YES' or stdout[i] == 'NO' for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: Each test case's output is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout[i] == 'YES') == (sum([1]*A + [2]*B + [3]*C) % 2 == 0) for i, (A, B, C) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the total sum of the multiset is even, otherwise 'NO'.
